facts.fact: 在 Dr. Cahill 的心理治疗中，Adam 一连几分钟都没回答她例行的开场问题 How are you?
facts.anchor: They’d gone a few minutes without him answering her first question, which was always her standard How are you?

facts.fact: Cahill 告诉 Adam：没有那么多“应该”，人无法强迫别人变成别的样子，也无法单靠意志驱走 PTSD。
facts.anchor: “There are no shoulds, Adam. You can’t force people to be what they aren’t and you can’t just will away your PTSD.”

facts.fact: Adam 曾经切断 Patrick 体内的魔法丝线——这比束缚（binding）更有效、也更永久。
facts.anchor: Adam had severed Patrick’s magic, the threads of it inside him. It was more effective and more permanent than a binding.

facts.fact: Adam 决意不让 Wolf 成真，必要时他会先切断 Ian 的魔法。
facts.anchor: Adam wouldn’t let him be. He’d sever Ian’s magic first.

facts.fact: Adam 说他洗牌切牌 three times（三次），抽出的始终是同一张 Five of Cups。
facts.anchor: “I shuffled and cut the deck three times, and it was always the same card.”

facts.fact: Cahill 点破：天气已经转暖，Adam 却仍然整日穿长袖，遮住他的疤痕。
facts.anchor: “It’s getting warmer out, but you still wear long sleeves all the time,” she said. “Covering your scars.”

facts.fact: Adam 承认 Vic 碰他时会退缩，听到有人摔门会吓一跳，他担心这永远好不了。
facts.anchor: “I can’t . . . when Vic touches me, I flinch. I jump when someone slams a door. What if it never gets better?”

facts.fact: Cahill 判定 Adam 正在悲恸：他失去的是纯真，他的疤痕不只是身体的、也是心理的。
facts.anchor: “You’ve had a loss of innocence. Your scars aren’t just physical, they’re psychological.”
